name: Screenshare Doctor
description:
Shows in the top bar whether screen sharing can work on this desktop, and why not: the portal, its backend, PipeWire and the session, checked read-only by the screenshare-doctor command-line tool whenever you open the menu.

Requires the screenshare-doctor tool from the project page (uv tool install screenshare-doctor). Nothing is started, changed or recorded; no screen-sharing request is made.
